description: Source code for helper functions related to creating and configuring media player parameters, including audio and video stream info, and handling player creation configurations.

methods.name: CreateAudioStreamInfo
methods.description: Creates and initializes an AudioStreamInfo structure based on the specified audio codec.

methods.name: CreateVideoStreamInfo
methods.description: Creates and initializes a VideoStreamInfo structure with default parameters.

methods.name: CreatePlayerCreationParam
methods.description: Constructs PlayerCreationParam using specified codecs and output mode, or from configuration with optional file inputs.

methods.name: GetPreferredOutputMode
methods.description: Retrieves the preferred output mode for a given PlayerCreationParam.
